name: Settings
open.detail: Manage plugins: aliases, shortcuts, startup, state and which ones are enabled
window.title: MyTools Settings
plugins.hint: Type an alias followed by a space to search only that plugin. Separate aliases with spaces or commas. Plugins set to start with MyTools load at startup; on-demand plugins load when first used. Write shortcuts like Ctrl+Shift+V; leave one empty for none. Saved changes apply right away.
error.alias: Alias “{alias}” of {name} must be one word of at most 64 bytes.
error.duplicate: Alias “{alias}” is used by both {first} and {second}.
state.idle: Starts on demand; not used yet
state.unknown: State unknown: MyTools is not running
logs.paused: Paused; new records are not shown
hotkeys.label: Shortcut for
error.hotkey: Shortcut “{hotkey}” of {name} is not valid; write it like Ctrl+Shift+V.
error.duplicate_hotkey: Shortcut {hotkey} is used by both {first} and {second}.
error.hotkey_launcher: {hotkey} opens MyTools and cannot be used by a plugin.
